Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
Having played with this card for years, I witnessed a difference in
ways that people use the card.

One way was for the player to skim through his deck from the top down,
while not revealing any cards to the other players, until he came to
his first piece of equipment.

The other ways was for the player to flip cards over until he revealed
an equipment card, which he then equipped.

Which one is the proper manner of play?

Comments Welcome,
Norman S. Brown, Jr
XZealot
Archon of the Swamp

The former. The effect does not allow other players to see any cards from the
library (including the one retrieved).

Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:


So how do you prevent cheating? The player searching his library may
come another piece of equipment and keep looking until he finds the
one he wants? When the player shuffles he erases any evidence of
impropriety that may have occurred.



Messages.Author: Dasein
Messages.Body:
> > The player searching his library may
> > come another piece of equipment and keep looking until he finds the
> > one he wants? When the player shuffles he erases any evidence of
> > impropriety that may have occurred.
>
> Ask the judge to observe if there's a question of honesty.
>
> See also superior Govern, et al.

Some more bad news: cards in the uncontrolled region can be shuffled
randomly around whenever anybody likes. True story. So I can govern
down on a guy, take the counters off him into my pool, govern down
again, take the pool off him again, then pay one to see one, shuffle
all my uncontrolled cards randomly around while giggling maniacally,
then bring out one of those vampires. And nobody can know which was
the one I governed down onto before. You cannot force a player to
indicate whether the vampire they just influenced out is the one they
governed down onto 5 minutes ago. Which makes it more ridiculously
easy to cheat with Governing down. Just keep doing it and bloating,
even if you don't have a younger vampire, then dig for one, shuffle
your cards around, and away you go! If you want to influence one out,
or if the game times out, nobody can bust you. Which I think is a
total pile of crap.

Apparently the answer to this is as always "call the judge when they
do it". But you know, it would make life easier for everybody (players
AND judges) if the player couldn't shuffle their uncontrolled guys
around, and you could point at a vampire and say "THAT is the one you
governed down onto, he better not turn out to be older, otherwise
you're a cheatin varmint." It shouldnt' be necessary in a tournament
environment (i.e. NOT playing with friends) to have to call a judge
over every 3 minutes whenever anybody governs down, enchants down,
plays a Cadet, or any of a hundred other things.

I hear where you are coming from on this one. I raised a stink about
this uncontrolled vampires thing a year or so ago but was thoroughly
shouted down by a whole bunch of people. Apparently everyone around
here thinks its fine for the game to be ridiculously easy to cheat in,
and just recites the usual "play with non-cheaters" or "call a judge"
mantras. Very miniscule rule changes that would have no real effect on
play or anything (i.e. a ruling that you can't shuffle your
uncontrolled vampires around, the only possible purpose of I can think
of would be, um, let's see, oh yeah, cheating with Govern down!),
would make it virtually impossible to cheat in VTES, but this is
apparently not possible, and such a change would apparently result in
violating various ancient obscure sacred tenents of VTES, the nature
of which I am obviously of vastly inferior intellect to understand.
*shrug* Go figure.

Lucky my social games are with cool people I trust. Tournaments are
different of course. But you know what? In a tournament, I can't
actually be bothered calling a judge over every time anyone does
anything with any unseen cards in any way (Govern type effects, Vast
Wealth type effects, etc.), and I bet you can't either. Nobody ever,
ever does. Because it would be a massive total pain in the bum and a
waste of everyone's time and would result in even more tables timing
out.

Cheat for teh win!!!!!!@!!!@!!
